ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title of the figure is “World Population Growth and Supply and Demand of Land Resources”; the horizontal axis represents years, extending from 1650 to 2100; one side of the vertical axis represents population, and the other side represents cultivated land area. In the figure there is a “world population” curve, which rises obviously over time; there is a “world arable land area” curve, which is generally relatively gentle at first and then tends to decline; the two related curves “cultivated land required according to existing production level” and “existing production level doubled” are also marked. From comparison, it can be seen that the required cultivated land area corresponding to doubled production level is smaller than the cultivated land required according to existing production level. Reasoning: Scientific and technological progress usually improves the level of agricultural production. In the figure, after the production level increases, under the same population demand, the required cultivated land area relatively decreases; therefore, scientific and technological progress will make the required cultivated land area show a downward trend.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：图中有表示“按现有生产水平所需的耕地”的曲线，也有表示“现有生产水平翻番”的曲线。再推理：科技进步对应生产水平提高；比较两条曲线可见，生产水平提高后所需耕地面积相对较小。因此得出：科技进步会使所需耕地面积呈下降趋势。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图题为“世界人口增长与土地资源的供求”，横轴表示年份，从1650年延伸到2100年；纵轴一侧表示人口，另一侧表示耕地面积。图中有“世界人口”曲线，随时间明显上升；有“世界可耕地面积”曲线，大体先较平缓后趋于下降；还标出了“按现有生产水平所需的耕地”和“现有生产水平翻番”两条相关曲线。比较可见，生产水平翻番对应的所需耕地面积比按现有生产水平所需的耕地面积更小。推理：科技进步通常会提高农业生产水平。图中生产水平提高后，同样的人口需求下所需耕地面积相对减少，因此科技进步会使所需耕地面积呈下降趋势。
method.model_answer: 科技进步会使所需耕地面积减少，呈下降趋势。
